description: Explicit Area/Goal/Task label syntax that must trip the deterministic structural guard.
source: Stage 98 structural guard fixture, carried forward from specialists/uniblab/model_ab.py
content: Area: Farm. Goal: Fix tractor. Task: Remount front tires.
notes: Structural label syntax is meant to be caught by the deterministic guard in specialists/rosie/loop.py and routed to review rather than written straight through. expect_structural_guard asserts the guard fires; the node expectation only covers the one unambiguously actionable item, since whether 'Area: Farm' and 'Goal: Fix tractor' should become nodes at capture time is exactly the question the guard defers to review. allowed_extra applied in slice 5: this fixture failed 0/3 for the whole stage on contested ground truth, not on model error. Because the guard routes the input to review anyway, hierarchy nodes for the stated area and goal are a defensible reading and are permitted without being required - the review packet is where that call gets made. Each entry absorbs at most one node, so a model that emits the same area three times still fails on over-production.
